definition: to fill a space until nothing more fits
description: A sunny beach road. A young man in sunglasses, a linen shirt and shorts leans with one leg stretched out and pushes hard with both hands to slide shut the door of a pale blue vintage van crammed full with things and a pink inflatable flamingo. Surfboards, bags and folding chairs are piled high on the roof rack. The door closes and he stands up. On the sand three friends cheer with their arms up, one sitting on a cooler, and a beach ball, frisbee and towel lie on the road.

taps.phrase: to force the van door shut
to stick out of the van
